title: Milestone Signal Lattice and Preflight Timer
body:
Purpose:
This is a working product-ops artifact that combines a compact milestone tracker, a prioritized set of launch signals (the "Signal Lattice"), and a day-by-day preflight timer for the two-week window before a go-live. Use this to: align owners, set clear metric thresholds, and coordinate contingency actions if signals degrade.

Scope and assumptions:
- Applies to feature launches that use hosted API + dedicated fallback (typical Redwood CI).
- Primary audience: product ops, release engineers, SRE, and PMs running staged activations.
- This is an evolving working doc — final signoff happens in the go/no-go call.

How to use:
1) Populate the milestone row (below) with dates and owners.
2) Review each signal and set thresholds appropriate for your cohort (canary vs full).
3) Walk the preflight timer with the cross-functional team starting D-14.
4) Use the "Escalation & Remediation" column to map to runbooks and quick fixes.

Milestone tracker (compact):
| Milestone | Date | Owner | Status | Acceptance artifact |
|---|---:|---|---|---|
| Canary open | 2025-02-12 | Evan Lopez | planned | Canary cohort config (GH#217) |
| 10% ramp | 2025-02-18 | Leah Summers | planned | Traffic routing manifest |
| 50% ramp | 2025-02-20 | Omar Nadeem | planned | Telemetry baseline (last 30d) |
| Full on | 2025-02-24 | Riya Patel | planned | Post-ramp smoke tests pass |

Signal Lattice (prioritized signals + thresholds + action):
- Safety signals (blocker if violated):
  * PII leak detection rate > 0 - immediate stop and incident channel (runbook: security/shutdown-PII).
  * High severity policy hits (policy-violations/hr > 1) - pause, escalate to legal/compliance.
- Quality signals (strongly weighted):
  * Eval set regression: BLEU/ROUGE/approx metric drop > 3% vs baseline -> rollback to previous model variant; open regression ticket (PRODOPS-4821).
  * User-visible error rate (generation NACKs / requests) > 0.8% over 10m -> throttle + revert quantization profile.
- Performance signals (operational):
  * 95th latency (in-region) > target (canary: 400ms, general: 250ms) for 5 consecutive minutes -> scale up dedicated pool or failover to cheaper region based on policy.
  * Token cost burn per 1k requests > budgeted by 30% -> enable lower-cost model variant (but check quality threshold).
- Reliability signals (supporting):
  * Cache hit ratio drop > 15% -> investigate prefix/keying regression; temporarily increase batching window.
  * Request error surge (5xx) > 0.5% sustained for 3m -> circuit-breaker to canary fleet.

Action matrix (simple):
- P0: immediate halt + incident bridge (security, legal, SRE).
- P1: pause ramp, roll traffic back to previous stable variant, notify stakeholders within 15 min.
- P2: reduce % traffic, flip to degraded mode (non-critical features off), schedule bug fix in next 24-48h.

Preflight timer (D-14 -> D+1) — core checklist by day: replace dates with launch anchor date.
- D-14: Confirm milestone tracker + owners. Validate monitoring dashboards exist for each signal. Dry-run the canary config in staging. Owner: Riya Patel.
- D-11: Finalize canary cohort list and approval from privacy. Run full eval harness (quality + policy). Owner: Leah Summers.
- D-8: Load test anticipated traffic patterns at canary scale. Verify batching, cache, and token-cost estimates. Owner: Evan Lopez.
- D-6: Security checklist — KMS key rotation window cleared, audit logs ingestion validated. Owner: Security oncall (linked).
- D-4: Alerting sanity: escalation contact list, runbook links, incident bridge alias, PagerDuty playbook, and postmortem template. Owner: SRE lead.
- D-2: Nightly smoke runs with the exact canary config (3 runs). Confirm no regression across 3 runs. Owner: Release Eng.
- D-1: Go/No-Go rehearsal with cross-functional attendees; confirm rollback path and communications draft. Owner: Riya Patel.
- D+1: Post-launch 4-hour health check, then 24-hour summary. Owner: Leah Summers.

KPI quick-reference (for the go/no-go call):
- Safety: 0 PII leaks, policy violations per hour = 0 (target).
- Quality: eval-change <= 1.5% drop vs baseline for canary; <=3% for ramp.
- Latency: 95P <= canary target (400ms).
- Reliability: 5xx <= 0.5% sustained.
- Cost: token cost delta <= +20% vs forecast for first 72h.

Escalation & remediation examples (links to runbooks in linked_artifacts):
- Latency spike -> runbook "sre/latency-fallback" (scale + regional shift). P1.
- Model regression -> revert model variant tag and re-run eval harness. P1.
- Security/policy -> immediate stop and security incident response (PRODOPS-SEC-LOCK). P0.

Open questions / items to resolve (working notes):
1) Do we need an automated cross-check between billing alerts and token-cost signal to avoid missing early cost regressions? (owner: Finance eng).
2) Confirm exact cohort IDs for canary — we currently have a provisional list; need legal OK for EU cohort. (owner: Leah).
3) Who owns the customer comms template for degraded outputs? Draft in GH PR linked above. (owner: PM)

Notes on metrics instrumentation (short):
- All launch signals must be wired into the rollout dashboard with 15s granularity for latency and 1m granularity for error/quality signals.
- Eval harness results should be pushed to the "evals" bucket and a baseline comparison auto-generated; failing comparisons should be a gating signal in the canary job.

Appendix: quick commands / references
- Canary traffic flip (CLI): rollouts flip --env prod --target canary --pct 10 --tag release/2025-02
- Quick revert: rollouts revert --tag stable/latest

End of doc — this is a living working doc. Tag any changes in the PR/Confluence links above and comment on this file when you update a threshold or owner.
